label: Tagatose
comment: Made from lactose here; today it is mostly made from starch or sugar instead.
note: About 92 % as sweet as sugar with 38 % of the calories. Today CJ CheilJedang (Korea) makes it from starch or sugar by enzymes; the lactose route is the Arla and Nutrilab one.

about.text: A rare sugar, a hexose that sweetens almost like sucrose with far fewer calories. From milk it is made by splitting lactose into glucose and galactose and then isomerising the galactose into tagatose.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
